title: UI Studio Brand Config
description: Brand configuration schema for the ui-studio skill. Extends the design-system-ux schema with optional layout and ux_writing blocks. Backward-compatible: configs generated by design-system-onboard (without layout/ux_writing) work in ui-studio with degraded capabilities. PROVISIONAL: prefix convention applies — token fields may contain 'PROVISIONAL: ...' string values from moodboard-driven extraction. Skills consuming this config MUST detect the prefix before using a value as a hard constraint.

description.description: Brief description of the brand's visual identity

temperature.description: Overall color temperature. Influences neutral color choices and dark section treatments.

personality.description: 1-2 sentence description of the brand's personality as expressed through UI

cluster.description: Style cluster fit. A=Clean/Structured, B=Warm/Human, C=Bold/Distinctive, D=Sustainable/Infrastructure, E=Craft/Studio

style_entry.description: Named style entry from the style reference library (e.g., 'Studio Craft', 'Civic Modern')

style_notes.description: Rationale for style selection, warning sign decisions, and documented exceptions (e.g., WS6 documented departure)

seed_color.description: Optional seed hex (e.g. '#2D5BFF') from which an accessible tonal palette can be generated via scripts/palette_gen.py. When present, tokens.color may be generated rather than extracted; mark generated values with source 'palette_gen' in field_provenance.

tokens.description: Design tokens organized by category. The tokens namespace is a delivery surface — no _note or _rationale keys inside it. Put documentation in meta.implementation_notes.

body_register.description: ADR-004. Encodes primary body voice register. Set to 'monospace-primary' when body/data zone is monospace-dominant (e.g., industrial/SCADA configs).

scale.description: Type scale with responsive values. Keys: semantic names (h1, h2, body, label, etc.). Values: CSS clamp() expressions or fixed sizes.

url.description: CSS @import or link href for web fonts

semantic.description: Success, warning, error, info. For ISA-101 SCADA clients, also include alarm_high_priority. Secondary shape/symbol encoding required — color cannot be sole indicator.

contrast_notes.description: Notes on contrast-safe and contrast-failing combinations

schemes.description: ADR-006. Dark/light parallel token sets. Present ONLY on dark-native configs where meta.default_scheme is 'dark'. Light-baseline configs omit this block.

page_padding.description: CSS clamp() for page-level horizontal padding

touch-target.description: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8. Enforce via min-height/min-width, not fixed dimensions.

register.description: Moment-type registers (Carbon 'productive' focused-task vs 'expressive' rare brand moments). Each maps moment-specific easing/duration keys. ADR-009.

choreography.description: Staging and stagger (IBM). entrance_order lists element classes most-orienting first to most-important last. ADR-009.

frequency_guidance.description: Atlassian heuristic: expressiveness scales inversely with interaction frequency. ADR-009.

focus.description: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13. Mandatory for civic, public-sector, healthcare, education clients.

color.description: Must achieve 3:1 contrast against adjacent unfocused background

logo.description: OPTIONAL. Asset-level logo system namespace (ADR-008). Authored by the heyhi-logo-system skill's Spec mode, NOT populated by design-system-onboard Mode D moodboard extraction. Carries mark asset references, clear-space and sizing rules, approved colorways with evaluated contrast, the scale-degradation reduction path, motion behavior, and a provenance meta block. Backward-compatible: configs without this block are unaffected. The non-tokenizable reasoning (mark typology, metaphoric weight, mark-to-type relationship) lives in the companion design-intent document, not here. (ADR-008)

marks.description: Mark asset references by role. Each entry (named or custom) points to a source asset (SVG preferred) and carries a usage $description. Named roles and additional custom roles share the same shape. (ADR-008)

primary.description: Primary lockup. Default for standard uses above minimum size.

asset.description: Path or reference to the source asset.

$description.description: Purpose and usage constraint per heyhi-token-description-author philosophy.

secondary.description: Alternate composition (e.g., stacked) for constrained ratios.

asset.description: Path or reference to the source asset.

$description.description: Purpose and usage constraint per heyhi-token-description-author philosophy.

icon.description: Symbol or reduced form for square contexts (app icon, avatar).

asset.description: Path or reference to the source asset.

$description.description: Purpose and usage constraint per heyhi-token-description-author philosophy.

monochrome.description: Single-color form for one-color reproduction, engraving, fax-grade contexts.

asset.description: Path or reference to the source asset.

$description.description: Purpose and usage constraint per heyhi-token-description-author philosophy.

asset.description: Path or reference to the source asset.

$description.description: Purpose and usage constraint per heyhi-token-description-author philosophy.

clearspace.description: Minimum clear space around the mark, expressed as a ratio to a named basis. Fully tokenizable. (ADR-008)

formula.description: Clear space as a multiple of the basis, e.g., '1x', '0.5x'.

min_sizes.description: Smallest size at which the primary mark may be used before switching to a reduced form. Fully tokenizable. (ADR-008)

colorways.description: Approved mark-on-background pairings, each with its evaluated WCAG contrast result. A colorway that fails its target is a finding, not a value. (ADR-008)

background.description: Background hex the mark sits on.

scale_degradation.description: Ordered reduction path from full lockup to smallest recognizable form. The thresholds are tokenizable; the judgment of what 'degraded but still recognizable' means lives in the design-intent document. (ADR-008)

below_px.description: At this size and below, switch to use_mark.

use_mark.description: Which mark role to use at this step (icon, monochrome, simplified).

reduction_path.description: Prose summary of the full reduction path.

motion.description: Entrance and state behavior for animated mark use. The 'never' list carries motion anti-descriptors. (ADR-008)

meta.description: Provenance and confidence for the logo namespace, matching the active-brand.json meta convention. (ADR-008)

path.description: Dot-notation path within the logo namespace.

illustration.description: OPTIONAL. Asset-level secondary illustration system namespace (ADR-011). The brand-led personality layer of single-color illustrations used as branding moments (large) and micro-graphics (small), plus the functional system-icon library decision. Authored when an illustration system is delivered (engagement / heyhi-logo-system), NOT populated by design-system-onboard Mode D. Sibling to logo and tokens. Backward-compatible; absent for brands without an illustration system.

set.description: Full illustration set as asset base names (e.g., 'tractor-1', 'shovel', 'wheelbarrow'). (ADR-011)

lead.description: The lead subset, allowed on trust-forward surfaces. Encodes the lead-with decision as data. (ADR-011)

held.description: The held subset, used only in narrow contexts and kept off trust-forward surfaces. (ADR-011)

assets_path.description: Directory of the recolored SVG variants (green / cream / charcoal / currentColor per item). (ADR-011)

fill.description: Default fill treatment. 'flat' solid fill is the default; a screenprint texture overlay is allowed at branding-moment scale only. (ADR-011)

colorways.description: Approved illustration colorways reusing the logo and brand palette, each with WCAG 1.4.11 graphic-object contrast results (3:1 target). (ADR-011)

sizing_tiers.description: Pixel ranges per usage tier. Optical sizing (shared visual weight), not a single bounding grid, since the silhouettes differ in proportion. (ADR-011)

usage_modes.description: Prose rules for the two modes. The non-tokenizable judgment (aesthetic, when-to-simplify) lives in the companion design-intent doc. (ADR-011)

texture.description: Optional screenprint / halftone overlay treatment, branding-moment scale only, never micro-graphics. (ADR-011)

system_icons.description: The FUNCTIONAL / system icon library, kept deliberately distinct from the brand illustrations. Carries UI iconography (controls, wayfinding, value props, list markers). (ADR-011)

weight.description: e.g., 'bold' to sit with heavy display type.

color.description: Recoloring approach, e.g., 'currentColor / brand green / charcoal'.

spec.description: Path to the companion human design-intent document. (ADR-011)

rights.description: Ownership / reuse note (e.g., client-specific with a studio test-and-reuse clause). (ADR-011)

meta.description: Provenance: version, gate_status, provisional_fields, matching the logo and tokens meta convention. (ADR-011)

layout.description: OPTIONAL. Layout and grid system configuration. When absent, ui-studio builds without Layout Declaration enforcement and spacing derivation. Configs from design-system-onboard (which lack this block) operate in degraded mode — token-driven builds without named pattern enforcement.

spacing_density.description: Drives section padding tier values. Never invent padding — derive from this field.

section_padding_tiers.description: Named tiers derived from spacing_density. Used in Layout Declarations.

preferred_patterns.description: Named layout patterns from layout-patterns.md that fit this brand's cluster and density. At least 2 entries enables full Mode A layout enforcement.

voice.description: Copy and voice rules. Absent means no voice constraints — flag to user.

ux_writing.description: OPTIONAL. Per-slot copy patterns for interface text. When absent, ui-studio writes copy from voice rules only. Each slot stores pattern, source, source_url, and last_verified for traceability.

pattern.description: One-sentence summary of the tooltip copy convention. Completeness signal for validate.py.
One-sentence summary of the CTA copy convention. Completeness signal for validate.py.
One-sentence summary of the form label copy convention. Completeness signal for validate.py.
One-sentence summary of the notification copy convention. Completeness signal for validate.py.
One-sentence summary of the onboarding copy convention. Completeness signal for validate.py.

custom.description: Brand-specific copy slots not covered by the standard eight slots.

components.description: Component library analysis. Generated by ui-studio-onboard or the component analysis process.

repository.description: Source repository connections. Auth tokens NEVER stored here — store env var names only. Actual tokens live in environment variables.

auth_header_env_var.description: Env var name for auth header (not the token value)

pat_env_var.description: Env var name — not the token value

version.description: 0.x.y = provisional (moodboard-derived, unconfirmed). 1.x.y = confirmed by designer. Promotion via validate.py --promote.

completeness_score.description: Computed by validate.py. Governs mode unlock thresholds: ≥90 full Mode A, 70-89 Mode A with approximations, 50-69 Mode B recommended, <50 hard stop all modes.

fidelity_score.description: G5. Computed by validate.py. Measures how much of the config has been confirmed against its source. Distinct from completeness_score: completeness = is it populated; fidelity = is it correct. Mode A requires fidelity ≥ 60. Version promotion requires fidelity ≥ 80.

taste_departures.description: Parallel to provisional_fields[]. Records human reviewer judgments that resolved a PARTIAL warning sign check result to CONSIDERED_DEPARTURE. Each entry documents that a pipeline check fired, a reviewer determined the departure is an intentional aesthetic decision supported by the style's taste_profile, and that the style's quality is carried by other means. All five required fields must be populated — an entry with any field missing is a documentation violation (Guard 6 in heyhi-pipeline-validator SKILL.md) and the check result must revert to PARTIAL until documentation is complete.

maps_to_bb.description: Boundary behavior ID from the style's taste_profile (e.g., 'BB-SC-01'). Criterion 1 (Boundary Map Gate) — must match a documented boundary_behavior in the entry's taste_profile. If no matching boundary_behavior exists, CONSIDERED_DEPARTURE is not reachable.

check_fired.description: The WS check or Stage check that produced the PARTIAL (e.g., 'WS2 Performed Translation'). Links this entry to the specific check result being resolved.

alternative_carrier.description: What carries the quality the check was protecting — named specifically, not asserted generally. Criterion 2 (Alternative Carrier Present). A rationale that asserts 'this is intentional' without naming the carrier is not sufficient.

not_a_departure_verified.description: Explicit confirmation that the boundary behavior's not_a_departure_if conditions are absent from this config. Criterion 3 (Not-a-Departure Conditions Absent). Must name the conditions checked, not simply assert they are absent.

revert_condition.description: Specific future conditions under which this CONSIDERED_DEPARTURE would revert to FAIL. Makes the judgment portable — a reviewer who did not participate in the original decision must be able to understand when this departure stops being considered.

gate_status.description: G2. Machine-readable record of human gate confirmations. Written by setup.py (all false/null). Updated during onboarding as gates are confirmed. validate.py enforces these as hard stops or warnings, not prose.

direction_lock_confirmed.description: Gate 0. True when the style cluster, temperature, and primary direction have been locked by the designer or client. Hard stop for Mode A builds until true. Must be true for version promotion.

direction_lock_date.description: ISO date when direction_lock was confirmed. e.g., '2026-03-25'.

designer_review_complete.description: True when a designer has reviewed the extracted token values against the source Figma file (or equivalent source). Warning at Mode A if false. Hard stop for version promotion if false.

designer_review_date.description: ISO date of the designer review.

designer_reviewer.description: Name or identifier of the reviewer (e.g., 'studio lead designer', 'client designer — Sarah M.').

mode_override_acknowledged.description: True when the operator has explicitly acknowledged that completeness_score is 50–69 and chosen to proceed with Mode A anyway. Not required for scores ≥ 70.

mode_override_score.description: The completeness_score at the time the override was acknowledged. Allows audit of what was known at override time.

field_provenance.description: G3. Maps token field paths (dot-notation) to provenance objects. Records where each value came from, when it was extracted, and when it was last verified. The structural foundation for fidelity scoring (G5), graduated confidence (G4), and engineer context (G6). Keys are dot-notation field paths (e.g., 'tokens.color.backgrounds.primary'). Required at extraction time — every extracted token must have a provenance entry.

source.description: Where the value came from. Values: 'figma', 'figma_variable', 'css_file', 'pdf_labeled', 'moodboard_visual', 'brand_doc', 'manual', 'inferred_from_context'.

source_url.description: Direct link to the source (Figma file URL, GitHub path, PDF page reference). null if not linkable.

confidence.description: G4. extracted = pulled from a reliable source, production-ready. inferred = estimated from visual inspection or description, directional. provisional = known to be approximate or incomplete, requires designer replacement. failing = known to violate a hard constraint (WCAG, brand rule), must not emit to CSS.

extracted_at.description: ISO date when the value was first extracted. e.g., '2026-03-25'.

last_verified_at.description: ISO date when the value was last verified against its source. null = never verified since extraction.

verified_by.description: Who performed the last verification (e.g., 'designer', 'studio lead designer', 'validator script').

notes.description: Free-form note about this specific field's provenance. Use for WCAG failure details, known drift, or exception documentation.

description.description: G6. Human-readable description of the token's purpose and usage constraints. Emitted as a CSS comment in cursor-export.py output. Used by engineers to understand when and how to apply this token.

usage_notes.description: G6. Specific usage constraints or warnings (e.g., 'Decorative use only — not for body text', 'WCAG: fails 4.5:1 on all backgrounds'). Emitted as a CSS comment alongside description.

default_scheme.description: ADR-006. 'dark' on dark-native configs only. tokens.color.schemes must be present when 'dark'.

implementation_notes.description: Free-form rationale for unusual token decisions. Use instead of _note keys inside tokens.*. Keys are field paths, values are explanation strings.

internationalization.description: ADR-007 Extension 5. Required for civic, government, multilingual-primary clients.

tokenLeaf.description: A design-token value: EITHER a bare scalar (legacy authoring, unchanged for every config onboarded before W5) OR a DTCG-native object per DTCG 2025.10. Both shapes resolve identically through resolve_token_value() in scripts/tokens.py (audit G7 / W5). Backward-compatible: the scalar branch preserves every existing config.

$value.description: The token value. Scalar for color/dimension/duration/cubicBezier/fontFamily; object/array for composite types.

$type.description: DTCG type. The codemod infers from category using heyhi-schema-extension-author Step 2 (color, dimension, fontFamily, fontWeight, duration, cubicBezier, boolean, string); other valid DTCG types may be hand-authored.
